questions.question: Which player in the database (2005 onwards) only represented South Africa in the test format?
questions.explanation: Jacobs played two tests against England in August 2003 and was active in provincial cricket until 2022.

questions.question: Who has achieved the 150+ runs and 3+ wickets in a match double more times, Susan Benade or Lanette Pienaar?
questions.explanation: Susan Benade: 1 times. Lanette Pienaar: 2 times.

questions.question: Who topped the wickets charts in the 14/15 season (T20 only)?
At which ground did Nicolien Janse van Rensburg record their career-best bowling figures (5-28, List A only)?
questions.explanation: It was at Recreation Ground, against Dolphins on 2024/10/12.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Matches as Captain' (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Susan Benade holds it, with a total of 119.

questions.question: Laura Wolvaardt set a database record (19/20 season, combined T20 + List A) with a value of 98. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Fastest 100 (by balls)', held by Laura Wolvaardt.
